notes.title: Update Notes
notes.notes:
Target Priority:
Now you can select a priority for towers

Tower Shooting Problem:
The tower shooting bug is fixed

The Game Difficulty:
The difficulty of the game is decreased

Towers Cost:
The cost of the towers has been decreased

Camera Movement:
Now you can move the camera by using the middle mouse button

Sound And Music Volume:
Now you can adjust the volume of sound and music background

Level Coin Rewards:
You can earn more coins from levels

notes.title: Marswar TD Update
notes.notes:
